Class F is counted on both sides because the 10-K says all classes share dividend and liquidation rights equally; excluding it would give 4.24% instead of 4.25%. Thiel holds through PLTR Holdings LLC, STS Holdings II LLC, Rivendell 7 LLC and Rivendell 25 LLC; 10,635,784 of his Class A shares are pledged, and 55,137,931 Class A plus 2,962,961 Class B shares are 'Designated Founders' Excluded Shares' outside the Founder Voting Agreement. pctVoting 8.1 is the proxy's figure for his own Class A and B shares and excludes the Class F votes; the three founders together control 49.999999%. 5% HOLDERS: the proxy states Vanguard (9.8%) and BlackRock (7.0%) as % of Class A only; on an all-shares basis they would be slightly lower (Class A is about 95.9% of all shares). They are recorded as stated, not recomputed. Their percentages of votes are 4.9% and 3.5%. The footnotes give only 13G/A filing dates (Jan 31, 2025 and Nov 8, 2024), not ownership dates, so holder asOf is omitted. No dividends: the cash-flow statement has no dividend line. Buybacks of $64.2 million were cash paid under the share repurchase program; $218.3 million of taxes paid on net share settlement of equity awards is excluded. No broad employee stock purchase plan is described in the 10-K, so plan is null.
